scope: Read-only source review of models.py, study.py and preserved official CfC source; no independent rerun

findings.cfc_time_derivatives: correct dm*elapsed for time_a and dm for time_b
findings.analytic_gate_derivative: erfc derivative sign and coefficient correct
findings.cfc_equations: match official default with backbone_layers=0; official Torch execution not available
findings.split_and_selection: disjoint actors; selected checkpoint written before test arrays load; input arrays contain no label feature

limitations_retained: Delay distractor donors cross actors; delay observations are dependent and only descriptive means are reported
Within-actor mispairing is different-recording, not a separately enforced different-emotion intervention
Target-phase bit labels original segment versus distractor; task is artificial tagged recall
Analytic gate reparameterizes a frozen gap each step, not a probability-conserving continuous first-passage path law or full HX
Equal CPU matches training body only; complete process costs are separate launch receipts
